beats.text: Who's the loneliest age group in the world? Not your grandparents.
Gallup and Meta asked people in a hundred and forty-two countries how lonely they feel.
Almost one in four adults said very or fairly lonely. That's more than a billion people.
The loneliest group: ages nineteen to twenty-nine. Twenty-seven percent.
The least lonely: sixty-five and older. Seventeen percent.
So if you're young and lonely, you're not the exception. You're the biggest group.

sources: Gallup & Meta (2023), Global State of Social Connections. 142 countries/areas (not China), fieldwork June 2022 – Feb 2023, ~1,000 respondents per country; 24% very or fairly lonely (>1 billion people); ages 19-29: 27% (highest), 65+: 17% (lowest). Via news.gallup.com.
